name: markdown-tool
description: Markdown annotations and synchronized outline/mind-map editing.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test:ui: node tests/ui-test.cjs && node tests/selection-ui-test.cjs && node tests/mindmap-ui.cjs
